TASK-1612 adopter + SIGPIPE rework READY for a fresh, different independent reviewer (author evidence only; no approval, TASK-1612 stays InProgress, production release unavailable).

Final head a5e1bc4f18aee6fb642b8c2d272b35e94b98ec68, tree 9d595b639008d233d96138b0f40512ea688cb001, base 5d4180e5ded8a55ad1b02beac5571c190d3da0ac, same branch task-1612-waiting-child-transport, fast-forward pushed and fetched-verified, worktree clean.

Remedy 1: probe/prepare observe the actual orphan adopter (owned non-exec probe orphan; bind its observed new parent only after it actually reaps within 2s; refuse subreaper caller / invisible / changed / non-reaping adopter). Remedy 2: probe control ends are socketpairs written with MSG_NOSIGNAL, so EPIPE is returned, never SIGPIPE; no signal-policy change.

Regressions: unchanged public profile under an isolated subreaper, all supervisors at SIG_DFL (probe-only success, public prepare, 5 lifetime barriers, non-reaping and subreaper refusals) plus a user+PID namespace-init control. Scratch nonvacuity: PID-1 declaration, no-reap, no-subreaper-guard, and the old pipe cleanup (signal 13) all fail; the fix passes.

Exact final tree: transport 11 passed; normal-CLI bootstrap, release compile-fail, CLI default/no-default checks, fmt/diff passed; check-ci-fast 21 passed (it was already red at 17b6ac3e, now fixed); 0 normal release symbols. One CLI check was killed by an external SIGTERM and rerun to pass. Full workspace in an independent clone is IN FLIGHT and not claimed; its result follows.

Report: .aida/handoff/task1612/ADOPTER_REWORK_READY.md; evidence: .aida/handoff/task1612/adopter-rework-a5e1bc4f/. Flagged CI risk: ci.yml enables unprivileged userns only after Run tests.
